run_findings.openhands_action_crash_recovery: PROVED_FOR_EXACT_SUBCLASS: Agent Server v1.44.1 repairs persisted RUNNING + unmatched executable ActionEvent stale-HEAD by emitting AgentErrorEvent explicitly parented to the action; upstream integration test exercises takeover plus next-turn view.
run_findings.openhands_user_message_crash_window: UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_LEVEL_GAP: send_message can persist a user MessageEvent before base_state leaf/last_user_message flush; cold load trusts a stale non-null leaf, while startup's explicit repair is action-specific. A source-qualified upstream regression candidate is persisted but not executed against the upstream package because it is unavailable in the current local runtime.
run_findings.mcp_task_pre_handle_ambiguity: CONFIRMED_EXACT_RELEASE in official C# SDK v2.2.0: IMcpTaskStore.CreateTaskAsync has no original-request/idempotency argument; WithTasks creates a task and schedules background execution before returning CreateTaskResult, so lost response + blind retry can create duplicate work absent an application/effect idempotency layer.
run_findings.mcp_task_store_durability: Official C# InMemoryMcpTaskStore uses a fresh Guid and does not persist across process restarts; stateless HTTP requires a shared singleton or external durable store.
run_findings.mcp_client_recovery: CallToolWithPollingAsync keeps taskId only in method-local polling state; crash-resumable clients should use CallToolAsTaskAsync, persist TaskCreated.TaskId immediately, then poll manually. This still cannot recover a task whose CreateTaskResult was lost before receipt.
run_findings.mcp_terminal_semantics: ttlMs may change/expire; cancel ACK is not stop proof; completed can embed tool isError=true.
run_findings.temporal_phase1: REJECTED_FOR_PHASE1_ACCEPTANCE: durable workflow comparison still requires Temporal Server plus Workers, leaving a resident executor dependency.
run_findings.phase1_acceptance: No zero-dependency mechanism accepted this run; no quota-bearing experiment consumed; incremental monetary cost 0.
